Label: FILE_NAMING_CONVENTION
ValidationReason: Invalid file naming convention. All reports must be submitted as JSON files, and the naming convention mandates the .json extension. The submitted file carries a .csv extension, so the file name does not match the mandatory format <FileType>_<DateDDMMYYYY>_<partN>_<partM>.json. The file was rejected before further processing and no records were processed.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the file name and resubmit the file in full.

Label: FILE_SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE
ValidationReason: JSON Schema validation failure. The structure of the submitted file does not conform to the expected MIDAS JSON schema structure. The entire file was rejected and no records were processed.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the file structure and resubmit the file in full.

Label: FIELD_MANDATORY_MISSING
ValidationReason: Missing required field: Crypto Asset Identification Code. All fields mandatory for alert production must be non-null. A null required field rejects the record.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: FIELD_TYPE_INVALID
ValidationReason: Invalid field format or data type for Price. Each value must match its defined data type and format. Numeric price and quantity fields are also pattern-checked against maximum decimal digit criteria.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: FIELD_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE
ValidationReason: Value out of range for Date and time. Values must fall within the acceptable ranges defined by the MIDAS system specifications, including acceptable date ranges.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: FIELD_VALUE_NOT_POSITIVE
ValidationReason: Negative or zero value detected in strictly positive field: Quantity. Fields expected to be strictly greater than zero (Quantity, Price, Initial quantity) are range-checked, so a value of zero is also rejected. Remaining quantity and Traded quantity permit zero but not negatives.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: RECORD_DUPLICATE
ValidationReason: Duplicate record detected. Execution records are duplicates when they share Trading platform for crypto-asset + Transaction Record Number + Trading platform for crypto-asset transaction identification code + Trading date time. Order book records use Order identification code + date(Date and time) + Status + Transaction identification code + Segment MIC + CASP Name. The first record is accepted and subsequent identical records are rejected.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission of this record required. Remove the duplicate at source to prevent recurrence.

Label: TIMESTAMP_FORMAT_MISMATCH
ValidationReason: Timestamp schema mismatch for Trading date time. The ingestion adapter for each CASP expects a single, strictly configured timestamp format across the entire file. The expected format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.fff, for example 2026-05-21T00:03:47.549. The submitted value drops sub-second precision and is rejected. A value that conforms to the format but differs from the other date and time values in the same file is also rejected.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: GTDV_VALIDITY_TIME_MISSING
ValidationReason: Validity period and time must not be null or empty if Validity period is GTDV. Validity period was submitted as GTDV (Good-Till-Date).
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: VALIDITY_TIME_NOT_AFTER_DATE_TIME
ValidationReason: Validity period and time must be greater than Date and time. The value must represent a timestamp chronologically after the Date and time field value, which here was 2026-05-21T00:03:47.549.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: TXN_ID_MISSING_ON_FILL
ValidationReason: Transaction identification code cannot be empty when Status is FILL or PARF. When Status is PARF or FILL, the Transaction identification code, Remaining quantity and Traded quantity fields must all be non-null. The submitted Status was PARF.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: TXN_ID_PRESENT_WITHOUT_FILL
ValidationReason: Transaction identification code must be empty if the value of Status is different than FILL or PARF. For all statuses other than PARF or FILL the field must be completely blank. The submitted Status was NEWO.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: EXEC_DETAIL_WITHOUT_TXN_ID
ValidationReason: Traded quantity and Transaction price must be empty when Transaction identification code is not populated. In the order book, where Status is not a fill (FILL) or a partial fill (PARF), these fields must be empty.
CorrectiveAction: Review the reason why these fields are populated for records that are not fills or partial fills. Correct at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: TRADED_QTY_EXCEEDS_INITIAL
ValidationReason: Invalid range: Traded quantity exceeds logical boundaries. Where Transaction identification code is populated, Traded quantity must be greater than or equal to zero and less than or equal to Initial quantity, which here was 122.79796175.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: LIMIT_ORDER_PRICE_MISSING
ValidationReason: Missing required field: Limit price / Transaction price. When Status is FILL or PARF and the order is a true limit order (Order type classification = LMTO), both Limit price and Transaction price must be non-null. The submitted Status was FILL and Order type classification was LMTO.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: REMAINING_QTY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS
ValidationReason: Mathematical bounds violation: Remaining quantity exceeds Initial quantity. Remaining quantity must be greater than or equal to zero and less than or equal to Initial quantity, which here was 122.79796175. A value of zero is permitted.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: TXN_PRICE_OUTSIDE_LIMIT
ValidationReason: Price range violation: Transaction price is zero or out of bounds relative to Limit price. When Status is FILL or PARF with Limit price populated and Transaction identification code filled, Transaction price must be non-null, greater than zero and strictly within the range established by Limit price, which here was 55.05500000 on a BUYI limit order. A buy cannot execute above its limit.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: ENUM_VALUE_INVALID
ValidationReason: Invalid enumerated value for Buy-sell indicator. BUYI and SELL are the only accepted values. The Side, Validity period, Order type classification, Passive or Aggressive Indicator and Status fields must equally match the pre-defined value sets published for each field.
CorrectiveAction: Correct the record at source and resubmit only the corrected record in the next submission.

Label: FIELD_LENGTH_EXCEEDED
ValidationReason: Field length limit exceeded. Maximum character constraints apply to text fields: Order identification code must be 50 characters or fewer and Transaction identification code 52 or fewer. The submitted value is 56 characters.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Review the value at source to prevent recurrence.

Label: MIC_NOT_IN_ISO10383
ValidationReason: Invalid execution venue Market Identification Code. The value must be valid against ISO 10383, except XOFF and XXXX which are permitted regulatory exceptions. This is checked unconditionally for execution records, and for order book records only when Transaction identification code is populated.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Review the value at source to prevent recurrence.

Label: DTI_NOT_IN_ISO24165
ValidationReason: The field is not valid against ISO 24165-2. Symbol and Crypto-asset identification code values are checked against the ISO 24165-2 DTIF registry. The submitted value is correctly formed as a nine character identifier but does not resolve to a registered Digital Token Identifier such as M2GR9LKZ6.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Review the value at source to prevent recurrence.

Label: MACRO_RATIO_ANOMALY
ValidationReason: Extreme order/trade ratio detected. File-level macro ratios apply: cancelled orders must be between 5% and 95% of total orders, the order Buy/Sell ratio must not be extreme (for example above 90% buy), and the execution Buy/Sell trade count ratio must be within +/-0.1% proximity. The file's Status mix is also compared against the CASP's own historical reporting pattern. Here the execution Buy/Sell ratio is 97.3% / 2.7%.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Investigate whether both trade legs are being captured upstream.

Label: PRICE_OUTLIER_ANOMALY
ValidationReason: Abnormal price discrepancy. Each execution price is compared against its immediately preceding and following executions for the same Price Currency and Trading platform for crypto-asset. This price diverges materially from both neighbours while those neighbours remain consistent with each other, which indicates an erroneous print rather than a genuine price movement.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Investigate the upstream price source.

Label: SEGMENT_MIC_WITHOUT_TXN_ID
ValidationReason: Segment MIC must be empty when Transaction identification code is not populated. This is the warning-level counterpart to the MET-011 rejection. The submitted Status was NEWO and Transaction identification code was empty.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Review the value at source to prevent recurrence.

Label: PASV_AGRE_INVALID_FOR_STATUS
ValidationReason: Conditional required field: Passive or Aggressive Indicator must be empty for the submitted Status. The field may only be populated when Status is PARF or FILL. For every other status it must be completely blank. The submitted Status was NEWO.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Review the value at source to prevent recurrence.

Label: MIDNIGHT_TIMESTAMP_ANOMALY
ValidationReason: Abnormal proportion of midnight-defaulted timestamps. The file is flagged when the proportion of Trading date time values set to midnight (00:00:00) exceeds a defined threshold, indicating upstream timestamp defaulting. Here 20.1% of values are midnight.
CorrectiveAction: No resubmission required. Investigate the upstream timestamp source.

Label: RECORDS_ACCEPTED
ValidationReason: 615 records triggered no validation rule and were accepted into MIDAS. This row is an aggregate count, not a reference to an individual record. Section 3.5.3 requires the feedback file to confirm the acceptance of records that triggered no validation rules.
CorrectiveAction: None required.
